That thought experiment is now, more or less, the stage design for Pastoral. Enlarged canvases arre embodied through dance. I tell Crowner that I recognise the feeling she is describing, the way a moving shadow can make you suddenly, acutely aware of time passing, of the odd proportion between a human body and the duration of a day.
What she wants from an audience, in the end, is not comprehension of any of this scaffolding but simply attention. “I hope people slow down,” she says. “Everything moves so fast now, we’re all embedded in our phones.
